```yaml
name: Check SLO Label

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled, unlabeled, opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-slo-label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'SLO')
    steps:
      - name: Check for SLO label
        run: |
          echo "SLO label is present on this PR."
          echo "Ensure the SLO workflow is triggered and completes successfully."
```
